submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Single production animation sprite, not a sheet.
Inputs: image1 is the exact NW idle identity, proportions and camera reference; image2 is corresponding historical walk pose to improve into actual RUNNING; image3 is front identity reference only (never copy its front camera); image4 is the approved primary painted STYLE reference, not UI content.
Create exactly one independent high-definition RUN pose of the same snow summoner girl. NORTHWEST, rear three-quarter view facing away toward upper LEFT at 45 degrees. Face mostly hidden, only a small left cheek sliver. Left fox hugging arm on near screen-left side, right crystal arm on far screen-right side. Keep the back of white/lilac short coat with purple BACK BOW; silver fox-face belt buckle only exists on FRONT, never add one to the back. Short silver-white bob, two furry ears, left-temple snowflake pin, same fluffy collar and short skirt, thigh/knee skin, same short fur boots. No extra tail on girl. ANATOMICAL LEFT arm continuously cradles exactly one little white fox against left ribs, left hand supports it. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand palm-up continuously supports the same small blue snowflake crystal. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs total, no unused extra arms. Preserve hands and props on their own sides; natural shoulder/elbow motion even while holding props.
POSE 15 FLIGHT APEX, RIGHT heel folded toward rump, LEFT shin reaches toward landing; body slightly elevated. RIGHT arm begins retreating from forward swing.
The legs must create a fast running stride with genuine forward travel, torso leans slightly forward, not walking and not a standing display of the crystal. Natural perspective foreshortening; feet stay aligned with the running direction, clear left/right support and swing. Robe follows hips and exposes the two knees/boots enough to read motion. Continuous small fox bob, robe/tassel follow-through.
Maintain the exact idle size and full-body framing: square transparent canvas, total character resting height roughly82% of canvas, top ear about10% from top, virtual ground92% canvas, hip centre x50%. Leave all ears, sleeves, crystal, boots and tassels safely inside canvas with clear margin. DO NOT zoom, enlarge head or crop, no ground shadow or backdrop. Clean bright rounded high-end Chinese Daoist chibi hand-painted look matching supplied identity and approved style. True RGBA transparency. No text, no particles, no motion blur, no duplicates or ghosts.
Flight constraint: BOTH boots are airborne, their lowest points above virtual floor y92% by 6 to 10% canvas height. Preserve body scale and raise hips with true bent-knee running flight, no star-jump. RIGHT shoulder/elbow location changes according to phase, not just wrist rotation.
